declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.policy_digest_is_injective
declarations.type: the resolved finite policy digest uniquely identifies allocation semantics

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.evaluated_allocation_conserves_total
declarations.type: every resolved policy evaluation conserves complete batch token cost

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.certified_allocation_conserves_total
declarations.type: a certified allocation inherits conservation from its resolved policy

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.same_digest_and_facts_replay_same_allocation
declarations.type: same resolved policy digest and identical batch facts replay the same allocation

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.replay_comparability_is_reflexive
declarations.type: every allocation certificate is replay comparable with itself

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.unsafe_digest_is_not_injective
declarations.type: a constant raw digest cannot identify distinct policy semantics

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.colliding_digest_breaks_allocation_replay
declarations.type: colliding policy digests produce different allocations for identical facts

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.same_policy_digest_without_same_facts_is_insufficient
declarations.type: same policy digest without equal batch facts does not determine allocation

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.cache_context_change_rejects_replay_comparison
declarations.type: a cache-context change rejects deterministic replay comparison

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteDeterministicAllocationPolicy.deterministic_replay_preserves_pareto_cost
declarations.type: deterministic replay preserves the allocated route cost used by Pareto comparison
